revenue.definition: money that is made by or paid to a business or an organization

proposal.definition: something (such as a plan or suggestion) that is presented to a person or group of people to consider

delegate.definition: to give a particular job, duty, right, etc. to someone else so that they do it for you

briefing.definition: to give information or instructions to (someone)

pitch.definition: a speech or act that attempts to persuade someone to buy or do something

conversely.definition: in a way that is the opposite of something else

fluctuate.definition: to change level, strength, or value frequently

plummet.definition: to fall suddenly straight down especially from a very high place

steady.definition: not shaking or moving : held firmly in one place or position

leverage.definition: to use something that you already have in order to achieve something new or better

demonstrate.definition: to prove (something) by showing examples of it : to show evidence of (something)

submit.definition: to give (a document, proposal, piece of writing, etc.) to someone so that it can be considered or approved

assign.definition: to give someone a particular job or duty : to require someone to do a particular task

surpass.definition: to be better or greater than (someone or something)

feasible.definition: able to be made, done, or achieved

streamline.definition: to improve the effectiveness of an organization such as a business or government

consensus.definition: a generally accepted opinion or decision among a group of people

decline.definition: to become lower in amount or less in number

agenda.definition: a list of matters to be discussed at a meeting

collaborate.definition: to work together with someone for a particular purpose

deadline.definition: a time or day by which something must be done

implement.definition: to start using a plan or system

negotiate.definition: to have formal discussions with someone in order to reach an agreement

promote.definition: to encourage something to happen or develop; to raise someone to a higher position

quarter.definition: a period of three months, inside a financial year

strategy.definition: a detailed plan for achieving success in situations such as business or war

vendor.definition: a company or person that sells something

baggage.definition: bags, cases, and containers that hold a person's clothes and belongings when they are travelling

boarding.definition: the act of passengers getting on a ship, aircraft, or train

currency.definition: the money that is used in a particular country at a particular time

destination.definition: the place where someone or something is going

itinerary.definition: a detailed plan or route of a journey

souvenir.definition: something you buy or keep to help you remember a holiday or special event

terminal.definition: a large building at an airport where passengers arrive and leave

transit.definition: the movement of goods or people from one place to another; stopping at an airport between flights

voucher.definition: a piece of paper or an electronic document that can be used to pay for goods or services

reservation.definition: an arrangement in which something such as a seat on an aircraft or a table at a restaurant is kept for you
